jina: Prohibition against forming armed forces other than public armed forces
maudhui: (1) It is prohibited for any person, organization or group of persons, other than the Government, to raise or maintain in Tanzania an armed force of any kind. (2) The Government of the United Republic may, in accordance with law, raise and maintain in Tanzania armed forces of various kinds for the defence and security of the country and the people of Tanzania. (3) It shall be prohibited for any member of the armed forces to join any political party, except that he shall have the right to vote referred to in Article 5 of this Constitution. (4) For purposes of this Article, “member of the armed forces” means a person employed on temporary or permanent terms in the Defence Forces, Police Force, Prisons Service or National Service.
